findings: The new runtime and larger batches reproduce both complete captured images within the existing one-byte tolerance and preserve exact coverage. This is offline draw evidence, not interactive desktop performance.

Blur loses sample contributions before reduction. Diagnostic alpha outputs for nine active taps are zero for multiple active taps; the final gather/add reduction correctly sums the already incorrect contributions. This is a numerical correctness failure, not a tolerance adjustment opportunity.
The candidate is rejected for desktop deployment pending a fix and complete requalification. Physical GPU/NPU drivers and baseline runtime are unchanged.
